usage: agentbreeder registry [-h]
                             {new,publish,import,fork,edit,list,verify,show,diff,used-by} ...

positional arguments:
  {new,publish,import,fork,edit,list,verify,show,diff,used-by}
    new                 Scaffold a version directory to edit
    publish             Publish an immutable version
    import              Copy a version directory from anywhere into the
                        project registry
    fork                Copy a built-in or shared version into the project
                        registry to change
    edit                Change files of a project version and publish it as a
                        new version
    list                List versions in the search roots
    verify              Re-check every version's integrity
    show                Show one version's manifest and files
    diff                Show what changed between two versions
    used-by             Show which projects declare, lock and deploy a version

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
